svg.aria-label: An example graph: goal, worker, parallel acceptance and code review, end-to-end test, PR, CI, then merge. A failed review, test or CI run returns through repair, implementation and review before delivery is retried. This illustrative animation is not a recorded run. Reviews, end-to-end tests and CI each fail before repairs pass. Merge is the final step; post-merge checks are outside this example.

g.text: turn your best engineer’s judgment into a process.
